note: Two generations overlap in this range. WK2 (4th gen, two-row, 115-in wheelbase) covers 2016-2021. The WL (5th gen) arrived first as the three-row 2021 Grand Cherokee L (official pricing June 7, 2021, while the two-row 2021 model on sale was still WK2), then as the two-row 2022 Grand Cherokee (official pricing Nov 3, 2021) and the 2022 Grand Cherokee 4xe plug-in hybrid (Jan 26, 2022). 2021 therefore has two entries below, one per generation; each year entry carries a `generation` field. Any 2022 carry-over WK2 sale is not priced here (no source fetched). Grand Cherokee L (three-row) prices are included only where the fetched source listed them (2021 L entry, 2025 rows). MSRP excludes destination. Stellantis/FCA did not publish full U.S. lineup pricing releases for the WK2 model years or for 2023-2024, so those years rely on cars.com research pages (label 'MSRP'; destination not stated on those pages, so `destination` is null unless an official figure was found).
